title: Mantis Shrimp Ka Bullet Punch 🥊 #shorts
idea: The Mantis Shrimp strikes its prey with a bullet-fast punch reaching speeds of 83 km/h and 1,500 Newtons of force.

lines.text: Samundar ka yeh chhota sa keda goli jitni speed se punch marta hai!
Peacock Mantis Shrimp ka punch 83 km/h ki speed se nikalta hai!
Yeh chhota sa claw 1500 Newton ki taakat se shikar ko todta hai!
Iska punch pani me itni tez hai ki do baar blast hota hai!
Insan ke paas 4 photoreceptors hain, par iske paas poore 16 hain!
Kya aapne kabhi itna khatarnak samundari jaanwar dekha tha? Comment karo!

facts.claim: The peacock mantis shrimp strikes at speeds of 83 km/h.
The impact delivers an instantaneous force of 1,500 newtons.
Mantis shrimp have 16 photoreceptor types while humans have 4.
